sloka: सुग्रीवम् सहनूमन्तम् सर्वाम्श्चैवात्र वानरान् ।ततो वज्रहनुर्नाम राक्षसः पर्वतोपमः ॥६-८-२१॥।।
transliteration: sugrīvam sahanūmantam sarvāmścaivātra vānarān ।tato vajrahanurnāma rākṣasaḥ parvatopamaḥ ॥6-8-21॥।।

translations.english: Then a Rakshasa called Vajrahanu, mountain like in form, enraged, licking lips with his tongue said these words.
